block_split: split a JAX array into an n_rows by n_cols block matrix using jnp.split
get_matrix_multiplication_tensor: create a 3D tensor T_n of shape n^2 x n^2 x n^2 representing matrix multiplication
algorithm_from_factors: build a JAX function that multiplies block matrices using a tensor factorization
benchmark_jnp_dot: benchmark the performance of jnp.dot on random matrices with configurable trials and dtype
benchmark_factorized_algorithm: benchmark a fast matrix multiplication algorithm defined by tensor factorization factors
